Current line: NOTE FROM A DRUID

Speaker: (narration)
When it's heard: Reading a sign: inspector note (after the zone is freed)
Current line: The door is warm because the compost is happy. The compost was always happy. We just forgot what that looked like.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
When it's heard: Talking to Brother Bramble (intro) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: I never thought I'd say it: the Dump is healing. The vines are only vines, the mushrooms are only mushrooms, and the Archdruid is herself again. She is mortified.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
When it's heard: Talking to Brother Bramble (intro) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: Breathe in. Go on. You may breathe deeply now. That smell is honest compost.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
When it's heard: Talking to Brother Bramble (intro) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: This morning Compostella walked straight to the row of royal trees and planted a twelfth. She didn't say why.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
When it's heard: Talking to Brother Bramble (intro) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: She just smiled at you on the way past.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
When it's heard: Talking to Brother Bramble (return) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: The stream is clean, the fields are calm and the zucchini has gone back to being a zucchini. Thank you. We owe you more than compost.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
When it's heard: Talking to Brother Bramble (return) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: Though NOBODY has explained who ate the compost. The raccoons have suddenly become excellent listeners.

Speaker: Granny Gristle
When it's heard: Talking to Granny Gristle (intro) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: Granny Gristle, junk-trader! The shed is just a shed again. The turnips are only turnips.

Speaker: Granny Gristle
When it's heard: Talking to Granny Gristle (intro) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: I had a little cry, then I planted a field. Shop's open, dearie. Welcome back to the sane side of farming. Heh!

Speaker: Granny Gristle
When it's heard: Talking to Granny Gristle (return) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: Day-old turnips, dearie, and not one of them looking at anybody. Finally, produce with manners. Heh!

Speaker: Billie Muckfoot
When it's heard: Talking to Billie Muckfoot (intro) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: Billie Muckfoot, animal handler! The herd's back, and the goat's eating a sign.

Speaker: Billie Muckfoot
When it's heard: Talking to Billie Muckfoot (intro) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: The sign's not eating back. I've never been so happy to see a goat ruin something.

Speaker: Billie Muckfoot
When it's heard: Talking to Billie Muckfoot (return) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: Every animal present and entirely un-mutated. I could cry. I might.

Speaker: Billie Muckfoot
When it's heard: Talking to Billie Muckfoot (return) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: Into a bucket. For the plants.

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
When it's heard: After freeing: Archdruid Compostella talks
Current line: Archdruid Compostella. I am told what happened to the barn. I cannot remember doing it. The barn, I gather, remembers me. I will help put it right.

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
When it's heard: After freeing: Archdruid Compostella talks
Current line: Ten years of the Rot in my roots. It spoke so quietly. It said I was needed. It said the whole world was waiting to grow.

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
When it's heard: After freeing: Archdruid Compostella talks
Current line: It was my own grief, wearing a seed. Thank you for helping me let it rot.

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
When it's heard: After freeing: Archdruid Compostella talks
Current line: The Dump will heal. The goat may take longer to trust me. Plant something, child. Anything. It will be glad of you.

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
When it's heard: After freeing: Archdruid Compostella talks
Current line: You are carrying a loss you cannot name yet, child. When you find its name, do not bury it in a jar. Death is not the end of them.

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
When it's heard: After freeing: Archdruid Compostella talks
Current line: Let it be the start of something in you.

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella

Speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
